items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Clyde made all the arrangements. I do know that, Clyde Hart.

ctx.x: According to the list I have of that same personnel, you did four vocals, right, 'Dream of You,' 'Seventh Avenue,' 'Sorta Kinda' and 'Ooh-ooh, my-my, oh-oh'?

Yeah, that's right. That's right. I don't know who wrote. I wrote one of those tunes, 'Sorta Kinda,' and I think 'Seventh Avenue,' Specs Powell wrote that. 'Dream of You,' Sy Oliver wrote that; but I don't know who did that 'Ooh-ooh, My-my, Oh-oh,' but Clyde made all the arrangements. I do know that, Clyde Hart.
And this is -- was not too long before Clyde died.
